## Engineering review

- [ ] API input is validated and errors are handled intentionally.

- [ ] AI output is labelled, source-attributed where relevant and remains human-approved.
- [ ] Images include meaningful alt text, credit and rights metadata.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, focus, semantics and reduced-motion behavior have been considered.
